name: tins-native
description: Native library builds (FFTW, OpenBLAS) backing the TINS.Native.<rid> (OpenBLAS, BSD-3-Clause) and TINS.Native.FFTW.<rid> (FFTW, GPL-2.0-or-later, opt-in) NuGet package families. Both libraries are still built from one manifest/vcpkg install per RID; the license split happens at staging/packing time, not here.
